sources.rationale: Binds to extracted route records: path parameters from FastAPI route patterns arrive as handler arguments chosen by the requester. Query and body parameters are injected from the handler signature and ride handler-parameter seeding (route records list path parameters only).

sinks.rationale: Redirecting to an attacker-chosen absolute URL is an open redirect.
The Starlette class FastAPI re-exports; either import spelling reaches the same redirect.
FileResponse serves the named filesystem path; an attacker-influenced path reads outside the intended directory.
The Starlette class FastAPI re-exports; either import spelling serves the same path.
HTMLResponse emits its body as text/html with no escaping; attacker text in the body is markup.
